newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fresenius Medical pref price linked to ord shares.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius Medical pref price linked to ord shares.

text.p: Fresenius Medical Care said Friday it will issue five million new non-voting preference shares worth a nominal 25 million marks in a bookbuilding procedure.
It added the issue price will be linked to the price of ordinary shares during the bookbuilding.
The subscription period runs from November 11 to November 22, Hansgeorg Hofmann, board member of Dresdner Bank AG, told reporters at a news conference.
Initially the group planned to issue only four million new shares.
Dresdner Bank, which together with CS First Boston is lead-managing the share issue, also said there will be an oversubscription, or green-shoe clause, for up to nominally 3.75 million marks.
The new shares will be listed on the Frankfurt bourse and the New York Stock Exchange with trading scheduled to begin on 26 November.
